id: AT-AP-30 (standing phrases, the this-once rule, gates re-ask, denials along the line)
note: 0.1.16 second review: standing_words_re keeps only clear standing phrases (don't ask again, no need to ask, feel free to, from now on, without asking, the whole word standing, until further notice/I say so, whenever/any time you want/need) and no match after not/don't/never/no within three words; V1 until, V3 negation, V4 long-standing, V5 whenever-one-time and V6 always read once; four real phrases still read standing. 0.1.16 split: a standing phrase in a clause (up to . ; ! ? or a line break) that also says this once, just once, only once, one time, this time, today only, only today or for now is not standing (U-34, U-35; U-36 has it in the next sentence). The gate tier does not ship: every gate re-asks. Denials count over every session on the own line from the writer to the reader (B between A and C), and an unreadable transcript on that line is counted (denied_unread).
